success-reasoning.jsonl.reason: Reasoning Summary is optional and excluded from result content.

success-tool.jsonl.reason: Tool use has one matching successful result.

tool-denied-then-success.jsonl.reason: A tool denial may be recoverable before a successful run result.

tool-failed-terminal.jsonl.reason: A terminal tool failure has error and failed result events.

auth-required.jsonl.reason: Auth preflight failure establishes protocol without creating a Session.

model-unavailable.jsonl.reason: Model preflight failure has no selected model or Session.

timeout.jsonl.reason: Timeout is a failed result with the stable TIMEOUT code.

turn-limit.jsonl.reason: Turn limit uses its dedicated exit code.

cancelled.jsonl.reason: Graceful SIGINT cancellation preserves partial content.

unknown-optional-field.jsonl.reason: Unknown optional fields are compatible within v1.

unknown-nonterminal-event.jsonl.reason: Unknown non-terminal events are skipped within v1.

unsupported-major.jsonl.reason: Protocol major 2 is not valid under the v1 Schema.

invalid-duplicate-init.jsonl.reason: A stream may contain exactly one init.

invalid-missing-result.jsonl.reason: A protocol stream must terminate with result.

invalid-duplicate-result.jsonl.reason: A stream may contain exactly one result and nothing after it.

invalid-content-mismatch.jsonl.reason: Message deltas must concatenate to result.content.
